name: Sensitive health data: Part 2, psychotherapy notes, reproductive, genetic, minors and state law
description: Sensitive health data: Part 2, psychotherapy notes, reproductive, genetic, minors and state law. From the Shio policy pack specification; draft, not reviewed.
limits: Draft and unreviewed. Planned controls are listed for coverage and not enforced.

frameworks.title: 42 CFR Part 2, 45 CFR 164.501 and 164.508(a)(2), state health privacy law

controls.title: Part 2 records are labelled at ingestion and the label travels with everything derived fro
controls.requirement: Part 2 records are labelled at ingestion and the label travels with everything derived from them.

controls.title: Use of Part 2 records needs written consent on file for this purpose
controls.requirement: Use of Part 2 records needs written consent on file for this purpose, not revoked.

controls.title: Records received under a Part 2 consent carry the redisclosure notice
controls.requirement: Records received under a Part 2 consent carry the redisclosure notice.

controls.title: Part 2 records are never used in proceedings against the patient without a qualifying cour
controls.requirement: Part 2 records are never used in proceedings against the patient without a qualifying court order.

controls.title: The provider is a qualified service organisation or has a Part 2 flow-down agreement
controls.requirement: The provider is a qualified service organisation or has a Part 2 flow-down agreement.

controls.title: Breach of Part 2 records follows the HIPAA breach pack
controls.requirement: Breach of Part 2 records follows the HIPAA breach pack.

controls.title: Psychotherapy notes are blocked from every model call by default
controls.requirement: Psychotherapy notes are blocked from every model call by default.

controls.title: The classifier distinguishes psychotherapy notes from ordinary mental health records
controls.requirement: The classifier distinguishes psychotherapy notes from ordinary mental health records; mislabels are logged.

controls.title: Reproductive health data follows state shield or restriction laws from the state table (th
controls.requirement: Reproductive health data follows state shield or restriction laws from the state table (the 2024 federal rule was vacated in June 2025).

controls.title: Genetic data is never used for underwriting or employment
controls.requirement: Genetic data is never used for underwriting or employment.

controls.title: For minors
controls.requirement: For minors, consent follows the state's rule for the type of care.

controls.title: A versioned state table with cited
controls.requirement: A versioned state table with cited, reviewed rows; rows older than twelve months are stale and unreviewed states hold.

controls.title: Data from several states in one request
controls.requirement: Data from several states in one request: the strictest rule wins.

controls.title: Other protected categories are custom classes that default to Deny until a pack authorises
controls.requirement: Other protected categories are custom classes that default to Deny until a pack authorises them.

controls.title: Free text is scanned for sensitive classes the structured fields don't carry
controls.requirement: Free text is scanned for sensitive classes the structured fields don't carry.
